svg.title: Shared compute execution timeline — FlashAttention V2
svg.desc: Conceptual production-RTL execution timeline for one query-head pass, not a cycle-accurate waveform. Horizontal positions show dependency order only, with no duration, latency, initiation-interval or stall scale. One physical 16 by 16 systolic array, Array A, has 256 PEs with INT32 accumulators and is reused for signed INT8 QK transpose and unsigned 8-bit exponential-weight times signed INT8 V in PV. A foreground Q tile is loaded once per query pass; K/V tiles are loaded together before each tile computation. d16 has one QK feature chunk. d64 accumulates four 16-feature QK chunks, retaining PE accumulators, before score dequantization. Q/K scale multiplication, registered dequantization, rounding, INT16 saturation and the supported inverse-square-root dimension shift precede masked softmax score capture. Sixteen online-softmax instances use valid/causal key masks and LUT exponential approximations; active rows maintain running maximum, running sum and output-rescale factors across KV tiles, starting fresh at the first tile. The core captures the complete score tile before softmax consumes it. In the 256-lane configuration, all 256 physical dequantizers process the tile in parallel with registered outputs; dequant_tile_ready is constant one and controller timing aligns capture. In the 16-lane configuration, 16 physical dequantizers process ordered groups zero through fifteen, with pipelined issue and retirement; tile_ready is asserted only after the last group retires. Both configurations retain the same 256-PE array and lane arithmetic. After exp_out_valid, the controller schedules PV on Array A. Each PV output-feature chunk is followed by fused prior-output rescaling plus the new PV contribution times scale_v. d64 performs four such PV/update pairs, d16 one. First-tile updates ignore prior output contents. After the final output chunk, a nonfinal KV tile returns to foreground K/V loading while retaining Q and online state; the final tile exits to output-buffer normalization using the final running sum. Normalization traverses one output-feature chunk for d16 or four for d64. With the production compact decode output setting, prefill traverses sixteen query rows and decode traverses only row zero; only accepted query rows update softmax/output state. V2 KV prefetch is hard-disabled. Loader read issue and returned-stripe capture, dequantizer batch issue and retirement, and output-buffer SRAM read/compute/write are pipelined. Registered output writes can retire in a following controller state; these conceptual boxes are not non-overlapping module busy windows. No exact floating-point equivalence or PPA result is claimed.
svg.text: Conceptual RTL timeline · dependency order only; no cycle or duration scale
One query-head pass. Online state spans KV tiles; the first tile initializes it.
Array A performs no new matrix product here
Next KV tile; keep Q and online state
d16 / d64: 1 / 4 QK feature chunks before dequantization; 1 / 4 PV–update pairs per KV tile; 1 / 4 normalization chunks.
Same Array A in both configurations: 256 PEs
All 256 scores converted in parallel, then captured by softmax.
Lane arithmetic is unchanged: scale, rounding and saturation.
Ordered batch indices — not clock ticks
16 scores / batch; softmax waits until batch 15 retires.
Pipeline activity: loader issue/return, dequantizer issue/retire, and output-buffer read/compute/write are pipelined.
Registered writes may drain into a following controller state; boxes show dependencies, not module busy windows.
Traversal: PREFILL 16 rows; DECODE row 0 (compact enabled). Fixed-point / LUT arithmetic; V2 KV prefetch disabled.
